title: Canonical intrinsic realization of embedded constant finite coefficients
statement: For a scheme X and a finite discrete topological commutative ring A of Type 0, take the constant-to-continuous map of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients], forget to the underlying condensed abelian ring object and pull back to X. Define finiteRealization from the derived category of modules over the pulled-back constant object discreteObj A to the intrinsic constant-ring derived category for ULift A as derived extension along this specific map followed by integralModelIntrinsicRealization of [def-sfb-integral-model-generator-data]. The point scalar map and its pullback preserve the unit and multiplication. All data are explicit composites of existing functors; there is no chosen comparison isomorphism. The constantFirstReduction and continuousFirstReduction functors are the actual derived extensions with explicit source and target categories; their definitions contain no chosen data. The constantResidueRealization and continuousResidueRealization are the explicit composites of restriction, actual reduction and intrinsic realization, with no intermediate data chosen.

def finiteRealization (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type) [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A]
    [IsTopologicalRing A] [Finite A] [DiscreteTopology A] :
    letI : HasSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} :=
      CategoryTheory.siteAbelianHasSheafify.{u + 1, u, u + 1} _
    letI : (Scheme.ProEt.topology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} :=
      CategoryTheory.siteAbelianWEqualsLocallyBijective.{u + 1, u, u + 1} _
    DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (discreteObj.{u} A) X)) ⥤
        Scheme.proEtaleDerivedCategory.{u} X (ULift.{u, 0} A)
